# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large concatenation of short call snippets, and only a modest fraction are genuine sales/enquiry calls. A very large share of the material is **internal-operations chatter**: Diwali gift distribution to dealers, driver/vehicle/loading coordination, "staff gone for lunch," e-way-bill/government-shutdown issues, bill-copy/invoice handovers, and payment-collection follow-ups between field staff and the office. These were excluded.

The genuine sales calls that remain show a single company — **Crayon Roofing and Structures** (also heard as "Rayon," "Kayaan," "Creon," "Cryon" due to transcription/accent — same company, confirmed by the Manali/Andarkuppam check-post factory address repeated across calls) — operating as a **metal-roofing-sheet manufacturer and roll-forming unit** in Manali, Chennai, selling B2B/B2C via inbound enquiry calls, telecalling, and dealer relationships. Volume of true outbound/inbound sales conversation is moderate (~40-50 calls); many are very short (price check, "send WhatsApp," "wrong number," "we don't stock that"). Given this, findings below should be read as indicative patterns from a mid-size but somewhat thin sales-call sample, not an exhaustive playbook.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is actually discussed:

1. **Metal (colour-coated) roofing sheets** — core product, made in-house from coil.
   - Brands/ranges mentioned: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragathi (Pragati)**, **JSW Radiance**, **Silver-On (JSW)**, **Asian Indira Dhanush**, **Asian Force**.
   - Thicknesses: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm (0.7 mm explicitly NOT stocked).
   - Colours: Sky Blue, Royal Blue, Off-White/Half-White, Dark Green ("Kali Sheet Green"), Grey, Terracotta/Red.
   - Sold by **square metre** (sheet) and by **kg** (coil), with explicit running-metre-weight conversions discussed internally (e.g., "0.47 → ~4 kg per running sq.m").
2. **Tile-profile sheets** — handled by a *different* Crayon factory, not the Manali metal-sheet unit. Staff explicitly tell customers "எங்க company-ல இல்ல, Amar/Everlast-ல பண்றாங்க" [we don't make it; Amar/Everlast makes it] when tile profile is asked at the wrong line.
3. **PUFF sandwich panels (wall + roof)** — 50 mm / 40 mm / 30 mm insulated panels, quoted per square metre including metal+foam+metal composite; higher price band (₹1650+GST/sq.m mentioned).
4. **Accessories for roofing**: L-flashing, ridge, gutter, crimp, cutter/end-caps, barge board — all custom-diagram driven, standard width 610 mm (price jumps if customer's cutter/flash width needs the "full sheet," i.e., >610 mm = double rate).
5. **Polycarbonate / FRP sheets** (Lexan brand) — 1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm (sometimes asked for 3mm/4mm/6mm/10mm which the company does NOT stock), Clear and Off-White, standard max length ~15 ft.
6. **MS structural items**: JSW channels/purlins ("Z," "C," "Purlin"), referred out to a colleague ("Venkatesh") for detailed specs.
7. **Screws / fasteners**: Tata Agri self-drilling screws (1 inch, 2 inch, M8 variants, full-thread), rust-free variants; sold in cartons (~200 pcs small box / 2000 pcs master box).
8. **Welding rods** (Tata, Rasi brand) — dealer-scheme items with box/carton-based volume incentives and gift schemes, mostly in the B2B dealer-relationship calls (Rajesh's territory).
9. Explicitly **NOT offered**: UPVC sheets, liner sheets, GI plain sheet in 80/120 GSM spangle grades (customers redirected elsewhere — e.g., "Arumuga Steel," "ஆரம்ப ஸ்டீல்").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one quote) and **₹445 + GST / sq.m** (another call, likely later/Pragathi variant)
- JSW Pragathi Color On Plus: **₹445 + GST / sq.m**
- JSW Color On Plus — per-sheet (10 ft): **₹1,466 + 18% GST**
- Asian Indira Dhanush 0.45 mm sky blue, 10 ft sheet: **₹1,251 + 18% GST** (+ loading charge extra)
- Asian Force 0.45 Indira Dhanush: **₹370 + GST / sq.m**
- Pragathi coil: **₹410 + GST / sq.m**; also quoted at **₹101 + tax/kg**, with a **₹3/kg discount for bulk coil** (→ ₹97-98/kg)
- Radiance: **₹435 + GST/sq.m**; kg-basis **₹118 + GST/kg**
- Generic sheet kg-rate quoted to a confused retail caller: **₹120/kg + GST** (worked out to ~₹142/kg landed; 400 kg parcel ≈ ₹56,782 incl. GST)
- Flashing/cutter: **standard width 610 mm = ₹655**; if customer's 3-side cutter dimensions exceed 610 mm (i.e., needs full sheet width ~900mm), rate **doubles** (~₹1,310/unit)
- PUFF panel: **~₹1,650 + 18% GST / sq.m** (~₹2,000/sq.m effective, used for AC-room/cold-room false-ceiling cladding)
- Polycarbonate/FRP sheet 2 mm: **₹800 + GST / sq.m**
- Clear polycarbonate 10 mm: **₹61 + tax / sq.ft**
- Tata Agri screws: 2" rust-free **₹4.66 + tax**; 2" regular **₹4.44 + tax**; 1" **₹2.93 + tax** (dealer), consumer price ~20 paise higher
- M8 self-drilling screw: **₹4.44 + tax** (dealer/Tata customer rate)
- Welding rod (Rasi brand) carton: **₹356/packet incl. tax** (recently moved from ₹336); competing brand ~₹300-330
- **Payment terms (repeated across B2B quotes)**: 50% advance, balance 50% before/at delivery; **transportation is always customer's scope** ("vehicle your scope," company does not deliver)
- Minimum order signals: dealers routinely push 100-carton / 300-carton volume targets for gift-scheme eligibility; retail polycarbonate jobs need "at least 10-20 sheets" to be economical to run.
- Price-increase chatter: field staff mention an upcoming **~6% price hike** and unofficial word of a bigger increase "after the 20th," urging dealers to lock orders before the mail notification lands.

## Objection Playbook

- **"Price is too high / size-based pricing confuses me"** (customer kept asking kg vs sq.ft vs sq.m) → Rep patiently re-explains unit basis, offers to send a WhatsApp quotation instead of verbal math: *"நான் உங்களுக்கு quotation-ஆ share பண்ணி விடுறேன்."* [I'll share you a quotation.]
- **Non-stock item requests (UPVC, liner sheet, 80 GSM GI, 0.7mm JSW, 3-10mm polycarbonate)** →
